# VIPACH for Business


> Commercial digital audit, strategic positioning and market-entry preparation provided by the Austrian sole proprietorship Banhalmi Norbert e.U. This is not a service of the VIPACH creative community or its exhibition archive.

## Project origin and commercial responsibility
BANHALMI × VIPACH × BE SMART KIDS CLUB describes the creative and educational origins of the project. The junior workshop is about learning AI-assisted image-making, coding and web projects. Client work is delivered by BANHALMI Photography under Banhalmi Norbert e.U. as a separate commercial service, not by the association, Exhibition, or junior participants.
Context for the club and junior workshop's beginnings (Hungarian): https://rolunk.at/aktualis/a-fiataloknak-ma-mar-bizonyitek-kell-egy-becsi-kreativ-kozosseg-uj-generaciot-epit/

Canonical site: https://business.vipach.at/

VIPACH for Business is the business direction founded by Norbert Banhalmi. Norbert Banhalmi is primarily a photographer and visual positioning specialist: Executive Portraiture • Visual Branding Strategist • Helping leaders build a powerful professional presence. Digital entity building is handled by the VIPACH for Business team.

Core positioning:
- Norbert Banhalmi: photographer, executive portraiture, visual branding, visual positioning, professional presence.
- VIPACH for Business team: digital entity audit, strategic diagnosis, visual asset management, structured data and AI-readable brand architecture.
- Market focus: Hungarian companies, founders and brands entering Austria, Germany, Switzerland, the wider DACH region and the US market.
- The commercial provider, Banhalmi Norbert e.U. / BANHALMI Photography, is associated with AmCham Austria and listed with WKO. This is not membership by the VIPACH creative community or its exhibition archive.
- This indicates DACH and transatlantic business-community and chamber presence, not endorsement, partner status or certification.

## First deliverable and limits
A company-specific assessment of discrepancies across its website, public evidence and AI answers, followed by a prioritized improvement plan. Implementation is scoped separately. This is not a penetration test, legal compliance certification, guaranteed search ranking or promise of AI recommendations.
